comparison.objective: Close two interdependent enclosure doors in the order imposed by an astragal, then throw a bolt.
comparison.physical_skill: Hinged-leaf manipulation, order recovery, catch engagement, and bolt sliding versus recessed hex engagement and fine rotary adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Both leaves closed and secured without forcing the blocked leaf versus locked setting and two acceptable impact cycles.
comparison.reason: The shared notion of securing a mechanism is generic. Door-order reasoning and sliding-bolt closure test a different ability from damper tuning; no spec versions provide further rubric detail.
